# Typography Guide

## Font Philosophy

**NEVER use default AI fonts** that scream "generated by AI":
- ❌ Inter
- ❌ Roboto
- ❌ Arial
- ❌ system-ui
- ❌ sans-serif (as primary)

**USE characterful fonts** that give your slides personality and premium feel.

## Recommended Font Pairings

### Modern Corporate

```html
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

```css
:root {
  --font-display: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
  --font-body: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
}
```

## Typography Scale for Slides

```css
:root {
  /* Base scale for 1280x720 slides */
  --text-title: clamp(56px, 6vw, 72px);
  --text-subtitle: clamp(32px, 3.5vw, 40px);
  --text-heading: clamp(28px, 3vw, 36px);
  --text-body: clamp(20px, 2.2vw, 28px);
  --text-caption: clamp(14px, 1.5vw, 18px);
  
  /* Line heights */
  --leading-tight: 1.1;
  --leading-snug: 1.3;
  --leading-normal: 1.5;
  --leading-relaxed: 1.7;
  
  /* Letter spacing */
  --tracking-tight: -0.03em;
  --tracking-normal: 0;
  --tracking-wide: 0.05em;
  --tracking-wider: 0.1em;
}

h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-title);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: var(--leading-tight);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight);
}

h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-subtitle);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: var(--leading-snug);
}

h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-heading);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: var(--leading-snug);
}

p, li {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: var(--text-body);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
}

.caption {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: var(--text-caption);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
}
```

## Advanced Typography Techniques

### Gradient Text

```css
.gradient-text {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}
```

### Text with Glow

```css
.glow-text {
  color: #00ffff;
  text-shadow: 
    0 0 5px currentColor,
    0 0 10px currentColor,
    0 0 20px currentColor;
}
```

### Outlined Text

```css
.outlined-text {
  color: transparent;
  -webkit-text-stroke: 2px #000;
}
```

### Variable Font Weights (for supported fonts)

```css
@supports (font-variation-settings: normal) {
  .variable-weight {
    font-variation-settings: 'wght' 650;
    transition: font-variation-settings 0.3s ease;
  }
  
  .variable-weight:hover {
    font-variation-settings: 'wght' 800;
  }
}
```

## Font Loading Best Practices

```html
<!-- Preconnect for faster loading -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

<!-- Load fonts with display=swap for better performance -->
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

## Anti-Aliasing

```css
body {
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}
```
